title: Magma Tree
body:
Description

The Magma tree is a fiery tree that grows in the Magma Caves, located in the lower section of Mike's Mines. Like Plek or Mysterious Mushrooms, Magma trees are incredibly valuable due to how difficult it is to obtain, requiring the successful navigation of the precarious and deadly Magma Caves.

It can be identified by its irregularly shaped burnt black trunk and glowing neon orange leaves.

Magma trees require an Industrial Sander to be sanded, however, it only requires a Steel Planker to plank. It may be more efficient to buy a Refined Saw at first to process your first few Magma trees.

Requires a Refined Axe or greater.

Obtaining

Magma trees are found in the Magma Caves, located behind a wall in Mikes Mines that that can be broken with explosives. Magma Trees also spawn at the site of a Meteor Crater, typically spawning 2 trees.

Trivia

  • The Magma tree is one of the few trees that have had their main spawn location moved, having previously been located around the Lighthouse. Their location was moved as a result of the map revamp on 21/07/2023.
  • Magma trees are currently one of the better ways to farm cash, with a full grown, multi-branched tree selling for ~$20-30K if sanded and planked. However, due to spawning in a dangerous and tedious location and trees falling in the lava causing losses, farming Mysterious Mushrooms can be an easier method of farming money.
  • The easiest way to access Magma trees is to find them from Meteors. Each meteor produces 2 trees, and can be sold for a lot of quick cash.
  • Due to its unique neon orange color, sanded Magma tree is ideal for use in builds that involve lava-like elements or neon lighting.
  • The Magma tree used to have opaque leaves, but they became translucent after the map revamp.
  • Magma tree leaves become lighter in color as colder seasons approach.
  • There is a bug that can generate double trunk Magma trees. Hese bugged trees require chopping both trunks to take it down. This bug often occurs with Magma trees spawned from a meteor crash site.
